dependencies.rationale: Exact resource, storage and customization operations consumed by the full model; no extension-host or generic filesystem capability.
Bounded immutable resource catalog and one theme snapshot slot. Build uses the real loader and serializer; runtime restores the real model.
Actual Node suite lifecycle retaining all upstream assertions.

divergences.summary: Move the complete pure theme implementation and token primitives to platform/theme so both chrome and editor consumers share it without reverse-layer imports. Retain all algorithms, registrations, public data and loading/customization/storage methods.

Original resource, storage and configuration inputs are injected through their exact consumed operations. Resources are immutable packaged strings, bounded to 256 reads per load. Snapshots use original toStorage/fromStorageData without a duplicate parser or runtime checkout access.

Remove the unused environment argument from IThemingParticipant and preserve the existing Proctor registry accessor. No registered upstream callback reads that argument; all lifecycle and collector behavior is retained.
Use the existing real test runner and a bounded read of the unchanged fixture in place of extension/file service mocks. Keep every upstream test and assertion.

verification.obligation: All original token style resolution cases including scopes, specificity, super type, language and semantic metadata pass unchanged.

All nine themes retain full token rules, color/font maps and semantic resolution through actual resource load and storage restore. Customization invalidates caches and resets; adapters reject unsupported resources/storage operations.
Preserve existing color precedence, wildcard/default overrides, derived values, includes, cycle/missing/invalid rejection and native projection boundaries.
